note: INSTAT's December 2025 action plan on disability statistics. DHIS2 appears only in two planned activities for 2026: training health agents in entering and analysing disability data in DHIS2 (20 million FCFA, to be sought from partners) and configuring disability indicators in the platform (10 million FCFA, 5 million secured from the State). These are plans, not statements of what is in use, so no fact.
